source.product: UNIDENTIFIED - there is no real product behind this asset. A generic warm-Japandi round pedestal dining table in solid oak, invented for the FRIDAY demo catalogue. Not a copy of, and not a confirmed match for, any retail SKU.
source.generation: Higgsfield multi_image_to_3d, four cropped views (front / three-quarter-front-left / side profile / rear) taken from one AI-generated product turnaround sheet made with the codex-image skill; should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=30000, symmetry_mode=auto, no rigging or animation
source.postProcessing: gltf-transform resize --width 1024 --height 1024 (texture resize only, no lossy re-encode, geometry untouched), then scripts/fit_glb.py per-axis fit to stand the piece on the floor (minY = 0) and centre its footprint on x/z

knownLimitations: No real product: the dimensions below are the generated mesh's own measured box, not a figure verified against any retail listing. Targeted 120 x 120 x 74 cm and landed 119.3 x 119.2 x 74.8 cm.

The generator returned the table noticeably squatter than a real dining table (189.9 cm across by 130.9 cm tall, a 1.45 width-to-height ratio against the real 1.62), so fit_glb.py used all 10% of its anisotropy cap to reach the target proportions. The top is therefore squashed about 10% relative to the mesh as generated.

30525 triangles, just over the 30000 triangle budget in backend/api/test_furniture_assets.py. Generated at target_polycount 30000 on the coordinator's instruction to favour looks over the gate; the coordinator owns any budget entry.
catalogueListingId is a synthetic demo listing, not a real article number, and its price is invented demo data.
Visual quality is UNVERIFIED: no render of the GLB was inspected. Only the source turnaround sheet was reviewed by eye.
The four source views are AI-generated renders of a table that does not exist, not photographs, so surface detail is plausible rather than accurate.
No manual Blender inspection or correction pass has been done.
